description: Process a holds a dynaset on table L positioned on row 4 (a long memo). Process b replaces that memo twice, keeping the file image after each; process a reads its row and then closes the Recordset and the Database (b is then the only opener); b replaces the memo again, appends a new row with a 9,000-character memo, sets DBEngine.SetOption(dbRecycleLVs, 1) in its own process, replaces the memo again and appends one more row, keeping the image after each. Asks how the file images and sizes differ across participant count and the recycle setting.
